Make good use of the Puff-shrooms' Plant Food effect along with Cherry Bombs to keep zombies away from your house!
Description.zh: 利用小喷菇的叶绿素效果，配合樱桃炸弹，尽可能让僵尸远离你的家！

Description.en: Is the lawn full of ice? No worries! Wasabi Whips will warm us up!
Description.zh: 场地被冰封了？不用担心，炙热山葵要为我们暖暖身子！

DefaultTitle.zh: 植物大战僵尸生日快乐！

DefaultDescription.en: Use powerful plants to chase away the bunnies on your lawn!
DefaultDescription.zh: 用强大的植物赶走草坪上的小兔子吧！
和植物伙伴一起庆祝春季的到来！
刚刚有人在喊“食物大战”吗？
这是一场盛大的万圣节变装秀！

DefaultDescription.en: Time to harvest your crops and protect your lawn from the onslaught of zombies.
DefaultDescription.zh: 是时候收割你的作物，并保护你的草坪免受僵尸的猛攻了。
